question: Under NTEP 2020 guidelines, CBNAAT (Xpert MTB/RIF) is the first-line diagnostic test for all presumptive TB cases and simultaneously detects both Mycobacterium tuberculosis and rifampicin resistance.

l10n.wrongAnswerMessage: This is actually true. Under NTEP 2020, CBNAAT (Xpert MTB/RIF) replaced sputum smear microscopy as the first-line test. It detects both the organism and rifampicin resistance simultaneously, enabling same-day diagnosis and immediate categorisation of drug-sensitive versus drug-resistant TB.
l10n.correctAnswerMessage: Correct. CBNAAT is NTEP's first-line test for all presumptive TB cases. It provides simultaneous detection of MTB and rifampicin resistance (a proxy for MDR-TB) within 2 hours, replacing smear microscopy as the initial investigation.
